Monday.description: They were cute as always. No notes here, except for love n kisses. Muahahahha!
Monday.title: *Babies enjoying the sun*

Tuesday.description: She was in a very playful mood today. I did give her a treat after this.
Tuesday.title: *Aurora being cute*

Wednesday.description: She loves her carpet! It has her face on it. I wonder if she knows that I love her.
Wednesday.title: *Aurora being fat n cute*

Thursday.description: She was very lazy this day. She's still unemployed.. maybe I should charge her rent.
Thursday.title: *Baby being so sleepy*

Friday.description: I don't really like mochi and he doesn't really like me. I wonder why.
Friday.title: *Mochi being depressed*

Saturday.description: Nebula loves waiting outside of the shower for me. This is my POV, shes so cute.
Saturday.title: *Nebs just being nebs*

Sunday.description: Every night they join me in bed. I wonder if they join because they like my bed or like me.
Sunday.title: *Ready for bedtime!*

Final.description: Ngl, every week my camera rolls gets bigger. But so does my love for my children.
Final.title: *My cute ugly baby*
